name: Babajka
source:
A young guy named Artem learns the news about the death of his friends at a local factory, he and his friend try to find out the cause of death, but they fail. Somehow, after a working day, the boy is going home and gets into a car accident, which was simply shrouded in a black cloud from nowhere and a monster appeared. Artyom and his friend are the only survivors of this terrible tragedy, when they got home they already understood that something was wrong with their city, the black cloud was everywhere. Artyom makes an important decision to leave his home and find a safe place, not even suspecting that the whole world has plunged into chaos.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230911225601/https://aniduo.itch.io/babayka]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个名叫阿尔乔姆的年轻人得知他的朋友在当地一家工厂死亡的消息，他和他的朋友试图找出死因，但他们失败了。不知怎的，一天的工作结束后，男孩回家途中遭遇车祸，不知从何而来的乌云笼罩着，一个怪物出现了。Artyom和他的朋友是这场可怕悲剧的唯一幸存者，当他们回到家时，他们已经明白他们的城市出了问题，黑云无处不在。Artyom做出了一个重要决定，离开他的家，寻找一个安全的地方，甚至没有意识到整个世界已经陷入混乱。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230911225601/https://aniduo.itch.io/babayka]Itch.io[/url]]
